resources.string: Leak! Traffic left outside the VPN
This copy runs inside the secure space (work profile) ✓
⚠️ This copy runs outside the secure space, so it has no VPN and shows your real IP (that is normal). For the test, open TunnelProbe with the briefcase icon.
Online: %1$d · Blocked: %2$d · Leaks: %3$d · New IP: %4$d · Direct: %5$d

How to test:
1. Add this app to the secure space with the outer TunnelLock, then open the copy inside the secure space.
2. Connect the VPN and tap Start. You should see Online with the server's IP and country.
3. Now break things: stop the server, switch Wi-Fi and mobile data, toggle airplane mode, or close TunnelLock.
4. The whole time you should only see Blocked. Leak means traffic left with your home IP.
5. Tap Copy log and send it for troubleshooting.

Every round tries four separate paths: HTTPS without DNS, HTTPS with DNS, IPv4/IPv6 and UDP (STUN).
Direct, no VPN (normal in the personal profile)
For long tests: remove the battery limit
